# lifecycle-hooks

preSave, postSave, and the rest. Your logic, our plumbing.

## README

# Lifecycle hooks

Attach behaviour to the four entity lifecycle moments: validation
(reject bad input), postSave (log every change), preDelete (block delete
when an invariant says no), postDelete (log after commit). This recipe
ships an `article` entity with hooks at each phase.

Hooks are how a feature inserts cross-cutting logic without the handler
body knowing about it. They run in the same transaction as the write
unless explicitly opted out, so a thrown hook rolls the whole change
back.

## What it shows

- **`r.hook({ type: "validation", target: handlerRef, handler })`** — runs before the
  handler body executes. Returns either `null` (pass) or an array of
  `{ field, error }` objects (fail). Used here to reject titles
  containing the word "spam" and titles longer than 200 characters.
- **`r.hook({ type: "postSave", target: { allOf: entityRef }, handler })`** — fires after every
  successful save (create or update) in the same transaction.
  `result.isNew` distinguishes create from update; `result.changes`
  carries the changed fields only.
- **`r.hook({ type: "preDelete", target: { allOf: entityRef }, handler })`** — fires inside the
  delete transaction. Throws on invariant violations (here: "published
  articles cannot be deleted") to roll the delete back. The handler
  receives the full row snapshot — no extra load needed.
- **`r.hook({ type: "postDelete", target: { allOf: entityRef }, handler })`** — fires after commit.
  External side effects (logs, notifications) belong here because
  failures cannot roll the delete back.
- **`ctx.lifecycle.afterRollback(fn)`** — the counterpart of `ctx.lifecycle.afterCommit`: runs `fn` when
  the handler transaction (or the enclosing savepoint of a nested `ctx.dispatch.write`) does not commit.
  Use it to give back something reserved outside the transaction, like the slot in
  `article:reserve-slot`. A failed COMMIT triggers it too, so write the callback idempotent.

## When to reach for it

You want logic that runs alongside writes — auditing, notification
emails, denormalised counter updates — without modifying the handler
body. The split between in-transaction and after-commit phases lets you
pick the right rollback semantics for each side effect.

## Source

The whole feature lives in `src/feature.ts` (~100 lines). Integration
tests exercise each of the four hook phases plus the rollback path on
preDelete violation.

```bash
bun kumiko test integration samples/lifecycle-hooks
```

```ts
// Lifecycle Hooks Sample — Integration Test
// Proves: validation rejects bad data, postSave tracks changes

import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import type { SaveContext } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { createEventsTable } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/event-store";
import { createTestUser } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { expectErrorIncludes } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/helpers";
import {
  setupTestStack,
  type TestStack,
  unsafeCreateEntityTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { articleEntity, articlesFeature, hookLog, reservedSlots } from "../feature";

let stack: TestStack;

const editor = createTestUser({ roles: ["Admin", "Editor"] });

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({ features: [articlesFeature] });
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, articleEntity);
  await createEventsTable(stack.db);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

beforeEach(() => {
  stack.events.reset();
  hookLog.length = 0;
  reservedSlots.clear();
});

describe("validation hook: single handler", () => {
  test("rejects title with banned word", async () => {
    const error = await stack.http.writeErr(
      "blog:write:article:create",
      {
        title: "Buy cheap SPAM now",
      },
      editor,
    );

    expectErrorIncludes(error, "title_contains_banned_word");
  });

  test("accepts clean title", async () => {
    const data = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "blog:write:article:create",
      {
        title: "Clean Article",
      },
      editor,
    );

    expect(data.isNew).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("validation hook: multi-handler", () => {
  test("rejects overly long title on create", async () => {
    const error = await stack.http.writeErr(
      "blog:write:article:create",
      {
        title: "X".repeat(201),
      },
      editor,
    );

    expectErrorIncludes(error, "title_too_long");
  });

  test("rejects overly long title on update", async () => {
    const created = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "blog:write:article:create",
      {
        title: "Short",
      },
      editor,
    );

    const error = await stack.http.writeErr(
      "blog:write:article:update",
      {
        id: created.id,
        changes: { title: "Y".repeat(201) },
        version: 1,
      },
      editor,
    );

    expectErrorIncludes(error, "title_too_long");
  });
});

describe("postSave entity hook", () => {
  test("logs create event", async () => {
    await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "blog:write:article:create",
      {
        title: "Hook Test",
      },
      editor,
    );

    expect(hookLog).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(hookLog[0]?.type).toBe("created");
  });

  test("logs update event with changes", async () => {
    const created = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "blog:write:article:create",
      {
        title: "Before Update",
      },
      editor,
    );

    hookLog.length = 0;

    await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "blog:write:article:update",
      {
        id: created.id,
        changes: { title: "After Update" },
        version: 1,
      },
      editor,
    );

    expect(hookLog).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(hookLog[0]?.type).toBe("updated");
    expect(hookLog[0]?.data["changes"]).toEqual({ title: "After Update" });
  });
});

describe("preDelete + postDelete entity hooks", () => {
  test("postDelete fires after a successful delete", async () => {
    const created = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "blog:write:article:create",
      { title: "Doomed" },
      editor,
    );

    hookLog.length = 0;

    await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>("blog:write:article:delete", { id: created.id }, editor);

    expect(hookLog).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(hookLog[0]?.type).toBe("deleted");
    expect(hookLog[0]?.data["id"]).toBe(created.id);
  });

  test("preDelete blocks delete when the article is still published", async () => {
    const created = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "blog:write:article:create",
      { title: "Live Article" },
      editor,
    );
    await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "blog:write:article:update",
      {
        id: created.id,
        changes: { isPublished: true },
        version: 1,
      },
      editor,
    );

    hookLog.length = 0;

    const error = await stack.http.writeErr(
      "blog:write:article:delete",
      { id: created.id },
      editor,
    );

    expectErrorIncludes(error, "published_article_cannot_be_deleted");

    // postDelete MUST NOT fire when preDelete rolled the tx back
    expect(hookLog.filter((e) => e.type === "deleted")).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  test("preDelete allows delete when article is not published", async () => {
    const created = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "blog:write:article:create",
      { title: "Draft Article" },
      editor,
    );

    hookLog.length = 0;

    await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>("blog:write:article:delete", { id: created.id }, editor);

    expect(hookLog.map((e) => e.type)).toEqual(["deleted"]);
  });
});

describe("scheduleAfterRollback", () => {
  test("keeps the outside-transaction reservation when the write commits", async () => {
    await stack.http.writeOk(
      "blog:write:article:reserve-slot",
      { slot: "kept", reject: false },
      editor,
    );

    expect(reservedSlots.has("kept")).toBe(true);
  });

  test("gives the reservation back when the write rolls back", async () => {
    const error = await stack.http.writeErr(
      "blog:write:article:reserve-slot",
      { slot: "released", reject: true },
      editor,
    );

    expectErrorIncludes(error, "slot_rejected");
    expect(reservedSlots.has("released")).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// Lifecycle Hooks Sample
// Shows: validation hooks (reject bad data), postSave entity hooks (track changes),
// preDelete hooks (block delete on invariant violation), postDelete hooks
// (log deletions after commit).

import {
  createBooleanField,
  createEntity,
  createTextField,
  defineEntityCreateHandler,
  defineEntityDeleteHandler,
  defineEntityUpdateHandler,
  defineFeature,
  type SaveContext,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import {
  ConflictError,
  UnprocessableError,
  writeFailure,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/errors";
import * as z from "zod";

export const articleEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_sample_articles",
  fields: {
    // maxLength high so zod lets long titles through — the validation hook
    // below rejects titles > 200 so the sample can demonstrate the hook path.
    title: createTextField({
      personal: false,
      reason: "is_business_data",
      required: true,
      maxLength: 1000,
    }),
    content: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data" }),
    status: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", default: "draft" }),
    isPublished: createBooleanField({ default: false }),
  },
});

// Collect hook events for testing
export const hookLog: { type: string; data: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [];

// Stands in for a quota held in an external system, outside the handler transaction.
export const reservedSlots = new Set<string>();

const editorWrite = { access: { roles: ["Admin", "Editor"] } } as const;

export const articlesFeature = defineFeature("blog", (r) => {
  const article = r.entity({ name: "article", ...articleEntity });

  const articleCreate = r.writeHandler(
    defineEntityCreateHandler("article", articleEntity, editorWrite),
  );
  const articleUpdate = r.writeHandler(
    defineEntityUpdateHandler("article", articleEntity, editorWrite),
  );
  r.writeHandler(defineEntityDeleteHandler("article", articleEntity, editorWrite));

  // --- scheduleAfterRollback: give back a reservation made outside the transaction when it does
  // not commit. The callback must be idempotent: a failed COMMIT also triggers it.
  r.writeHandler({
    name: "article:reserve-slot",
    schema: z.object({ slot: z.string(), reject: z.boolean() }),
    access: editorWrite.access,
    handler: async (event, ctx) => {
      const { slot, reject } = event.payload;
      reservedSlots.add(slot);
      ctx.lifecycle.afterRollback?.(async () => {
        reservedSlots.delete(slot);
      });
      if (reject) return writeFailure(new UnprocessableError("slot_rejected"));
      return { isSuccess: true as const, data: {} };
    },
  });

  // --- Validation hook on create: reject banned words + length ---
  r.hook({
    type: "validation",
    target: articleCreate,
    handler: (data) => {
      const title = data["title"] as string;
      if (title.toLowerCase().includes("spam")) {
        return [{ field: "title", error: "title_contains_banned_word" }];
      }
      if (title.length > 200) {
        return [{ field: "title", error: "title_too_long" }];
      }
      return null;
    },
  });

  // --- Validation hook on update: length check on title changes ---
  r.hook({
    type: "validation",
    target: articleUpdate,
    handler: (data) => {
      const changes = data["changes"] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
      const title = changes?.["title"] as string | undefined;
      if (title && title.length > 200) {
        return [{ field: "title", error: "title_too_long" }];
      }
      return null;
    },
  });

  // --- postSave entity hook: log all saves ---
  r.hook({
    type: "postSave",
    target: { allOf: article },
    handler: async (result: SaveContext) => {
      hookLog.push({
        type: result.isNew ? "created" : "updated",
        data: { id: result.id, changes: result.changes },
      });
    },
  });

  // --- preDelete entity hook: block delete when the article is still published.
  // preDelete runs inside the write transaction and throws on violation, so
  // the delete rolls back before any projection or event is written. The
  // payload.data carries the full row snapshot taken just before delete —
  // no extra load needed.
  r.hook({
    type: "preDelete",
    target: { allOf: article },
    handler: async (payload) => {
      if (payload.data["isPublished"] === true) {
        throw new ConflictError({
          message: `article ${payload.id} is still published`,
          i18nKey: "errors.publishedArticleCannotBeDeleted",
          details: { reason: "published_article_cannot_be_deleted", entityId: payload.id },
        });
      }
    },
  });

  // --- postDelete entity hook: log deletions after the transaction commits.
  // Default phase is afterCommit so failures here can't roll back the delete.
  r.hook({
    type: "postDelete",
    target: { allOf: article },
    handler: async (payload) => {
      hookLog.push({
        type: "deleted",
        data: { id: payload.id },
      });
    },
  });
});
```
